universe: rows of forward_shadow_v1 scores_<D>.parquet minus STAR (688/689) and BSE (.BJ, 8*, 4*, 92*), no switch

signals.cgo_outage: cyq_perf ffill(limit=5); beyond 5 sessions the cgo pillar is missing (no substitute)
signals.rank: pct rank over universe rows with a finite score

book_rules.pct: kept = held & pct >= 1-hold; size = #(pct >= 1-enter & buyable); fill with the best unheld entry names; equal weight 1/N on every rebalance (pre-registered v1.0 rule)
book_rules.topk_cap4: descriptive only (parameters chosen after the confirmation read): size 30, keep held names ranked <= 90, fill by rank with <= 4 names per SW L1 industry, equal weight; decision stores the top 400 ranked names + industries of (top 400 | hold zone)
book_rules.missed_rebalance: a sub-book whose signal night has no decision keeps its old book and is non-official until its next decided rebalance
book_rules.bench_ew: equal weight of universe(D-1), daily, suspended = 0

rhythm: 5 staggered sub-books; sub-book k rebalances when (official sessions since anchor) % 5 == k; book return = mean of the 5 sub-book daily returns
execution: forward_shadow_v1 D4: T+1 open; buy blocked if not traded or open >= limit-up - 0.001; sell blocked if not traded or open <= limit-down + 0.001 (held, sold at the first sellable open, cash until next rebalance); prices = stk_factor OHLCV first, daily_<d> fills missing codes
official: written before T+1 09:30 Asia/Shanghai, clock re-read after scoring right before the write; deadline not computable -> false; universe from proxy -> false; K-line gate fail (incl. NaN prices on traded rows) -> no decision; Core7P books also need x_jump_ms_v1 ann fetch ok for D or D-1, and no decision is written while x_jump_ms_v1 runs or (until deadline - 60 min) while that fetch is not ok; every decision with any non-official book gets a gaps.jsonl row (late / non_official_inputs / core7p_ann_stale)
schedule: Hermes weekdays 23:50 --today-session (+ parity of the previous session), 07:40 and 08:55 --prev-session after the A2 pre-market self-heal, 09:35 --prev-session cut-off; ops/hermes/stock/forward_shadow_multi.sh
continuous_track: all decisions drive the paper portfolio; reported separately; never re-decided

evaluation.primary_1: aegis_core7p_10_30 - ew6_retain_15_30 daily net (9.6bp), Newey-West t lag 5, official days
evaluation.primary_2: ew6_retain_15_30 - rebal_15 (approved retain rule): pass = diff > 0 & t >= 1.5 & turnover ratio <= 0.7 at 2027-11-30; close = diff <= 0 & t <= -1; else continue to 2028-11-30
evaluation.secondary: aegis_micro5p_10_30 - ew6_retain_15_30; each Aegis book vs bench_ew; 15.1bp and 20bp versions
evaluation.power_note: sd of the daily-diff series ~8.6%/yr (dev); a true +6%/yr gives expected t ~0.7 after 1 year and ~1.0 after 2 years, so the looks mainly detect harm; passing a boundary early is unlikely
evaluation.futility: at any look from 2027-11-30: t <= -1.0 -> close the Aegis book
evaluation.before_first_look: status and counts only (no return statistics printed)
evaluation.warm_up: the first 6 sessions after the anchor are excluded (research ex[6:])
evaluation.reported: 9.6bp / 15.1bp / 20bp; official days; official days without cgo-degraded days; one-way annual turnover per book and the retain / rebal turnover ratio
evaluation.degraded_days: report with and without cgo-degraded days

burn_in_for_today: 15 valid official sessions (gaps do not reset the count): official, no proxy, K-line gate ok, parity Spearman >= 0.999 between the stored score and a next-day recompute
